subject: Re: ASPEST kickoff - abstain smartly, label smartly
body:
Dmitri,

Plan for the window:

- Ondrej Bergstrom is committed at 60% to this project for May 2026 - he owns the ASPEST repro across all six benchmark pairs, which is the whole May milestone. I've structured the month so nothing else touches him.
- Halima Toure 50% through July: integration design with the human-review routing layer, then the pilot eval methodology.
- Wanjiru Horvat 40%: dataset engineering - the manual downloads (cinic10, the two wilds sets fmow and amazon_review, otto from the competition dump) plus build_datasets.sh runs on our infra, all landing in a shared $DATA_DIR by May 8.

Compute: 48 A100s on titan-a100 best effort; the active-learning loops are many small jobs rather than big ones, so scheduling matters more than raw capacity.

Flag: the repo pins an old Python 3.7 environment; Wanjiru is containerizing it rather than fighting our base image.

Alina
